findings.message: `saveOrder(order)` is not awaited, so the handler can return 201 before the order is persisted. A failed save then becomes an unhandled rejection, and the client is told the order exists when it may not.

The express checkout handler creates an order without identifying the signed-in user or tying the order to them. Anyone can create orders that belong to no one, and later ownership checks on those orders cannot work.

`req.body` is cast to `Cart` with no validation, so malformed or attacker-chosen data goes straight into `orderFromCart`. This includes missing items, non-integer or negative amounts, and client-supplied prices. That can crash the handler or produce wrong totals.
